# Shared junction pairs

Use only when exactly two independently reviewed same-status native operations (one addition and one removal) genuinely share a source junction. Declare `shared_junction_pairs` with exact ordered member IDs, source junction mask parts, and hash-bound preimplementation review of the complete member operations, original assignment and base. No intermediate replaces original authority.

The topology validator retains each member's own mask, native counts, polarity, zero outside-mask geometry/pixels, unchanged style references and numerical limits. Only the declared pair may overlap, only within its fixed junction in every declared view. It also verifies original-bound commutative replacement and positive isolated and marginal visible contributions. Undeclared overlaps still fail. A typed `shared_junction_review` binds pair IDs, review hash, original authority, junction union, per-view overlap and contribution evidence through both existing release gates.

Pair support does not approve geographic truth, widen member masks, waive source preservation, permit added/removal reclassification, or replace independent final visual review. Real final-page fixtures and the actual final card must each run the full native checker; synthetic tests and source-only probes do not constitute release evidence.
